title: HB 228 (2021-2022 Regular Session (first year)): Elections; certain driver's licenses and identification cards shall not be proper identification for presentation to a poll worker; provide
urls: https://www.legis.ga.gov/legislation/ (HB 228 detail API answers 401; not bypassed). History from House Journal 2021 (first reading; referred to the Special Committee on Election Integrity) and 2022 House Journal index "No Action in 2022".
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1 (O.C.G.A. 21-2-417(a)) - proper identification at the polls
(quote) "(a)(1) Except as provided in subsection (c) of this Code section, each elector shall present proper identification to a poll worker at or prior to completion of a voter's certificate at any polling place and prior to such person's admission to the enclosed space at such polling place. (2) Proper identification required under paragraph (1) of this subsection shall consist: (A) Consist of any one of the following: (1)(i) A Georgia driver's license which was properly issued by the appropriate state agency, except as provided for in subparagraph (B) of this paragraph; (2)(ii)   A valid Georgia voter identification card issued under Code Section 21-2-417.1 or other valid identification card issued by a branch, department, agency, or entity of the State of Georgia, any other state, or the United States authorized by law to issue personal identification, provided that such identification card contains a photograph of the elector, except as provided for in subparagraph (B) of this paragraph; (3)(iii) A valid United States passport; (4)(iv) A valid employee identification card containing a photograph of the elector and issued by any branch, department, agency, or entity of the United States government, this state, or any county, municipality, board, authority, or other entity of this state; (5)(v)    A valid United States military identification card, provided that such identification card contains a photograph of the elector; or (6)(vi) A valid tribal identification card containing a photograph of the elector; and (B) Not consist of a driver's license or identification card issued to a noncitizen, including, but not limited to, a driver's license or identification card issued pursuant to Code Section 40-5-21.1."
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 2 (O.C.G.A. 40-5-21.1(d)) - marking on licenses issued to noncitizens
(quote) "(d) A temporary license, permit, or special identification card issued pursuant to this Code section shall include, in a prominent location, the term 'BEARER NOT A U.S. CITIZEN -- NOT VOTER ID'."
(section) Sec. 3 (new O.C.G.A. 40-16-9) - E-Verify (RIDE) program
(quote) "40-16-9. On or after July 1, 2021, the department shall participate in the Records and Information from DMVs for E-Verify (RIDE) program of the United States Department of Homeland Security. The commissioner shall promulgate rules and regulations for the department's participation in such program."
(other) Sec. 1: 21-2-417(a) (proper ID at polls).
(other) Sec. 2: 40-5-21.1 new subsection (d).
(other) Sec. 3: new 40-16-9 (E-Verify RIDE participation).
(other) Sec. 4: effective date. Sec. 5: repealer.
